rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a concrete, material template. Both directives address youth welfare through a cabinet-level presidential body paired with a citizens advisory body. They follow a closely parallel operative sequence: establish and compose the governmental council or committee; assign it coordination, stimulation, and improvement functions; establish a citizens advisory committee or council; define that body's advisory role; require presidential reports; and provide interdepartmental assistance. C11 and C02 contain especially close language for alternate members, agency cooperation, and section 214 staffing, but neither matches the child's distinctive two-body youth-policy architecture as comprehensively as C15.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Committee on Juvenile Delinquency and Youth Crime ... composed of the Attorney General, the Secretary of Labor, and the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Council on Youth Fitness ... composed of the Vice President ... the Attorney General ... the Secretary of Labor, and the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a presidential interdepartmental body concerned with youth and assign overlapping cabinet membership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee ... shall review, evaluate and promote the coordination ... shall stimulate experimentation, innovation and improvement in Federal programs.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Council shall promote the efficacy of existing programs and the launching of additional programs ... [and] seek to coordinate, stimulate, and improve the functions of Federal agencies.
shared_material.explanation: The child's central operative duties closely reproduce the parent's distinctive coordination–stimulation–improvement formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Citizens Advisory Council ... [of] persons ... recognized authorities ... or ... leaders in programs concerned with juvenile delinquency or youth crime.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Citizens Advisory Committee on the Fitness of American Youth ... composed of such members as the President may designate.
shared_material.explanation: Both create a separate citizens advisory body alongside the governmental youth body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Council shall furnish the Committee advice and recommendations with respect to the matters with which the Committee is concerned.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Council shall be the President's official link with the Advisory Committee. The Council shall meet with the Advisory Committee ... [and] prepare and present reports ... to the President.
shared_material.explanation: The later order adapts the same machinery connecting the governmental youth body, a citizens advisory body, and presidential reporting.
